# My World@Mail.Ru

> > My World@Mail.Ru is a Russian social networking platform connecting classmates and friends with integrated media streaming and community features.

My World@Mail.Ru (Мой Мир) is Mail.Ru's flagship social network serving Russian-speaking users across Eastern Europe and the former Soviet republics. The platform combines social networking with integrated video, music, games, and community features, functioning as a comprehensive entertainment and social hub.

## Core Features

- [My World@Mail.Ru: stay in touch with your classmates and friends](https://my.mail.ru): My World homepage - Mail.Ru social network for connecting with classmates and friends
- [Video Mail.Ru](https://my.mail.ru/video): Video platform on My World with entertainment content and streaming service
- [Музыка Mail.Ru – слушать лучшую музыку онлайн](https://my.mail.ru/music): Music streaming service with catalog, playlists and popular tracks discovery
- [Группы   на Мой Мир@Mail.Ru](https://my.mail.ru/my/communities): Community groups directory featuring humor, sports, films, music and relationships
- [Каталог игр и приложений - Мой Мир@Mail.Ru](https://my.mail.ru/apps): Games and apps catalog with RPG, strategy, casual games and applications
